Payslip

The Payslip view displays comprehensive payroll information for an employee, including earnings, deductions, and employer contributions.

This view provides a complete breakdown of an employee's pay for a specific period, showing how the net pay is calculated from gross earnings.

Available Actions

From this view, you can perform several actions:

• Edit - Modify the payslip details

• Print - Generate a printable version of the payslip

• Email - Send the payslip directly to the employee's registered email address

• New Payment - Create a payment transaction for the net pay amount

Payslip Components

The payslip displays the following key components:

• Gross Pay - Total earnings before any deductions

• Deductions - Amounts subtracted from gross pay (such as taxes, insurance, or retirement contributions)

• Net Pay - The final amount payable to the employee after all deductions

• Employer Contributions - Additional amounts paid by the employer (not deducted from employee pay)

Period Totals

When enabled, the payslip can display cumulative totals for a specified period, showing year-to-date or custom period totals for all earnings, deductions, and contributions.

To learn how to create and edit payslips, see: Payslip — Edit
